notes: Each event is dated by the cited NASA source. 'precision' states how exact the date is. Events derived from the BASS-II table are computed from the CSV at request time and are not listed here.

events.title: SPICE conducted aboard the ISS
events.summary: Laminar gas-jet diffusion flames studied in the Microgravity Science Glovebox.

events.title: NASA reports FLEX flammability-limit result
events.summary: A NASA Glenn overview states that FLEX research to date shows a lower flammability limit in reduced gravity.

events.title: Saffire-I conducted after Cygnus departs the ISS
events.summary: The first remote Spacecraft Fire Experiment ran inside an Orbital ATK Cygnus cargo vehicle after it left the station.

events.title: Saffire-II completed
events.summary: NASA states Saffire I and II were completed in June and November 2016 respectively.

events.title: ACME gaseous-flame research begins on the ISS
events.summary: A NASA paper states that six gaseous-fuel flame experiments have been carried out on the ISS since 2017 using the Combustion Integrated Rack.

events.precision_note: Planned ignition date stated in a release issued two days earlier.
events.title: Saffire-III planned ignition
events.summary: NASA describes Saffire-III as the final test in the first phase of large-scale flame-growth experiments.

events.title: BASS-II Summary Report published
events.summary: NASA/TM-20210011385 collects the BASS-II principal-investigator reports, including extinction, flame-spread and flammability-boundary results.
